 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Copy the nonempty pattern in a rectangular frame to equal-sized frames.

    Other empty rectangular frames are removed when their dimensions differ.
    """
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    boxes = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        # The objects in this task are rectangular frames with complete borders.
        if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)) and
                all(grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
            continue
        pattern = [[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
                   for r in range(r0 + 1, r1)]
        occupied = any(any(row) for row in pattern)
        boxes.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1, pattern, occupied))

    sources = [b for b in boxes if b[6]]
    if not sources:
        return out
    # Exactly one frame carries the irregular pattern in the demonstrations.
    source = sources[0]
    scolor, sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1, pattern, _ = source
    sh, sw = sr1 - sr0 + 1, sc1 - sc0 + 1

    for color, r0, r1, c0, c1, _old_pattern, occupied in boxes:
        if color == scolor:
            continue
        same_size = (r1 - r0 + 1 == sh and c1 - c0 + 1 == sw)
        if same_size:
            for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    out[r][c] = color if pattern[r - sr0 - 1][c - sc0 - 1] else 0
        else:
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                    out[r][c] = 0
    return out
"
}
